corrections.text: The Overview states that, according to the ByteDance Seed blog, Seed 2.1 was released on June 23, 2026 'at the 2026 Volcano Engine Force Conference.' The ByteDance Seed blog confirms the June 23, 2026 release date but does not name the Volcano Engine Force Conference; that venue detail comes from AIBase, which reports the launch took place 'at the 2026 Volcano Engine Force Conference.' The facts are accurate but the conference-venue attribution belongs to AIBase, not the ByteDance blog.
